json.text:
I've compiled a list of common materials I need. 
What they are and how to obtain them is listed below. 

These are likely not always the only way to obtain these resources; in fact many will probably have more convenient ways unlocked as I progress.

sections.value: The runeforge's heat is able to break down bones into a fine ash. I should be able to use this ash for multiple magical purposes.
Using a transmutation cantrip, I can target certain blocks placed within the world to transmute them into something else.
- Arcane Stone is transmuted from Stone.
- Arcane Sandstone is transmuted from Sandstone.
- Quicksilver is transmuted from Copper Blocks.

json.text: I've detailed more about Cantrips in their entirety under the Manaweaving section of this Codex.
